agrarian agitator

He was the brother of CMY’s nurse Maria (Mason) Reeves (if the identification of Maria Mason with Mrs Reeves is correct).

Coleridge, Life, 80-1; John Keble’s Parishes, 96-7; Charlotte M.

Yonge, An Old Woman’s Outlook in a Hampshire Village(London: Macmillan: 1892), 65-7; Joseph Mason: Assigned Convict 1831-1837 ed.

David Kent and Norma Townsend (Melbourne: Melbourne University Press 1996), 3.
